scIntro.message: Build a size chart for your listing. It starts from standard ready-to-wear conversions; replace the measurements with your garment's own before you publish.

scPlusNote.message: Straight-size letters (XL, XXL, XXXL) and plus-size letters (1X, 2X, 3X) are different scales; plus-size is cut roomier at the same nominal label.
